purpose: Convert a broad SPIDER archive corpus into reproducible, provenance-preserving batches of locally relevant text chunks, group repeated patterns, preserve neighboring context, and expose pattern co-occurrence without promoting retrieval structure into evidence or causation.
pipeline: archive records remain immutable raw input
normalize text without rewriting source wording
split each record into overlapping word chunks
score each chunk against a versioned pattern-family manifest
retain matching chunks plus bounded neighboring chunks
group retained chunks into deterministic batches
build pattern-family co-occurrence and source-family maps
emit one versioned dossier JSON plus JSONL chunk projection
pattern_rule: Pattern aliases are retrieval operators, not claims. A family may include literal terms, spelling variants, and pre-registered semantic synonyms, but matching a family does not establish the mechanism named by that family.
